claim: the successor graph is acyclic, with depth bound 4. The exported point is a rank function on the four players; the conditions require every rank to be non-negative and to drop by at least one along each edge the twelve edge certificates declare present. A function with those properties exists only on an acyclic graph, and it bounds the longest path out of player i by rank_i. Combined with the four solo certificates this gives A4 for this game: the essential-APS recursion can produce a nonempty piece for player i at step k only from a path of k edges out of i, so every iterate is empty from step 4 on. The step from there to `no sequentially perfect Flesch absorption path` is Krasikov Prop. 4.9, a human theorem and not part of this certificate; and A4 closes the jump-free regime only together with (L8), see the simultaneous_quit group.
